TaskDescription: Quiet wakefulness with eyes closed. One minute of artifact-free data from the first sleep cycle (sleep stages) or quiet wakefulness, as selected by the MNI Open iEEG Atlas authors. Source paper (Frauscher et al. 2018, Brain 141:1130, Methods): 60 s sections "(either continuous or consecutive discontinuous >5 s segments after artefact exclusion)" of "resting wakefulness EEG with eyes closed recorded during standardized conditions", part of the controlled 'eyes closed and eyes opened' recordings of the clinical intracranial EEG evaluation.
InstitutionName: Montreal Neurological Institute (MNI Open iEEG Atlas); multicentre data from three tertiary epilepsy centres (Frauscher et al. 2018, Brain 141:1130), coded G, M and N in the channel names

AntiAliasLowPass_and_Resampling.Description: Resampled to 200 samples/s (unless that was the original rate) after a low-pass anti-aliasing filter at 80 Hz (source readme_MNI_Open_iEEG_Atlas.txt, Preprocessing 1).

AdaptivePowerLineRemoval.Description: Adaptive power-line interference reduction: high-pass 48 Hz FIR (order 100, 38-48 Hz transition) to estimate instantaneous phase/amplitude of line harmonics, first-order IIR smoothing, subtraction of 3rd, 2nd harmonic then fundamental (source readme, Preprocessing 2). 50 Hz for site G, 60 Hz for sites M/N.

PerSegmentMeanRemoval.Description: Mean of each segment and channel subtracted (source readme, Preprocessing 4; changelog June 2018).

iEEGReference: Bipolar montage between adjacent contacts of the same electrode (each channel is a bipolar derivation; source: one bipolar channel per column).
iEEGPlacementScheme: Clinically determined implantation (stereo-EEG depth electrodes and/or subdural grids/strips) for presurgical evaluation of drug-resistant focal epilepsy. Only bipolar channels with normal activity were released: in normal tissue on MRI, outside the seizure onset zone, without interictal epileptic discharges or overt slow-wave anomaly, in grey matter (Frauscher et al. 2018, Brain 141:1130, Methods).
